app.title: Cyber Shield
error.title: Couldn't load the game

menu.tagline: Fight viruses, collect rials, and upgrade your weapon with safe choices.
menu.name: Your name or nickname

stages.title: Stages
settings.title: Settings
settings.reduceMotion.help: Fewer particles, no flying coins, same reward.
settings.noShake.help: The screen stays still on hits and blasts.
settings.quality.help: “Auto” lowers quality on a slow device.
wallet.label: Your balance in Omani rials
stage.title: Stage {n}: {name}
tut.title: Quick training
tut.move.touch: Drag your finger on screen to move
tut.dodge: Dodge the red shots. Firing is automatic
tut.shoot: Stay under an enemy so Cyber hits it. Rials fly to your wallet
tut.hit: You got hit! In training you lose nothing
lost.title: Out of health
lost.text: It's okay, every fighter falls sometimes. Back to the start of the stage.
lost.kept: Your balance is as it was before the stage: {amount} rials. What you collected this try ({lost}) doesn't count.
pause.title: Paused
pause.text: Game paused. A short countdown starts when you return.
quiz.fix: Tap the correct answer to continue.
bonus.title: Challenge mastered!
summary.title: {name} summary
summary.question: Question {n} reward
summary.perfect: Three correct answers: you got every reward!
summary.encourage: Review the answers to learn why. Replay the stage for new situations and another chance.
review.title: Answer review
review.note: For learning only: this adds no rials and won't change your score.
final.title: You saved the System Core!
final.practice: You need another try at the questions to pass.
weapon.arc.l3: Sparks jump to two nearby targets.
weapon.disc.l5: Five bounces with a small blast on every hit.
weapon.wave.l5: Two waves in a row at full width.
box.title: Cyber box question
box.incoming: Cyber box! Hit it to win a special power
box.none: No power this time. The next box is a new chance.
box.practice: Quick practice: it won't change your score.
power.bomb.desc: Clears small enemies and shots, and hurts the boss.
power.laser.desc: A light beam burns all ahead for 3 seconds.
power.freeze.desc: Freezes enemies and shots for 5 seconds.
power.guard.desc: Extra heart, full protection for 6 seconds.
power.mega.desc: Clears the screen and takes a quarter of boss health.
upgrade.label: Upgrade your weapon to level {n}
lost.upgrades: Anything bought or upgraded this try was undone and refunded to your balance.
low.one: One heart left! Dodge the shots
low.onePower: One heart left! Use your special power
arms.label: Weapons
arms.open: Open the weapon shop: change your weapon or buy one
code.title: Final Challenge: Code Monster
code.intro: The Code Monster, the strongest boss, throws code symbols at you. No questions: just a fight.
code.brackets: When its brackets close, your shots do nothing. Wait for them to open, then hit.
code.reward: First win reward: {amount} rials and the “Code Crusher” badge.
code.rewardDone: You already won the reward. Now it's for challenge and fun.
code.note: Just for fun: it won't change your score.
code.win: You proved you're stronger than the hardest boss.
code.paid: Reward: {amount} rials and the “Code Crusher” badge.
code.again: A new win! The reward is paid only once.
box.rareIncoming: Rare box! Answer two questions to win Total Awareness
box.oneMore: Great! One more question to win Total Awareness.
box.oneMoreWrong: One question left: get it right for a normal power.
box.rareHalf: One of two correct: you won a normal power instead of Total Awareness.
box.rareNone: Both answers missed. The rare box will return one day.
power.aware.desc: A huge blast destroys all on screen and takes two fifths of boss health.
codex.title: Virus Encyclopedia
box.heartIncoming: Heart box! Hit it and answer to get hearts back
box.heartNone: No hearts this time. Dodge the shots well.
power.wall.desc: A wall blocks all enemy shots for 6 seconds. A firewall stops entry without permission.
power.scan.desc: A scan line sweeps the screen and hits all it crosses. A scan finds malware.
power.backup.desc: Works by itself: lose all hearts and you return with two. A backup restores what you lost.
power.update.desc: Weapon is a level stronger for 8 seconds. Updates boost protection.
power.backup.auto: Backup works by itself when your hearts run out
coop.title: Play with a supporter
coop.intro: Invite a friend to fight in your arena. Progress and score stay yours; they support you and earn rials for their weapon. Together it's harder!
coop.create: Make a room, invite a friend
coop.err.code: Type the code of five letters and numbers.
coop.err.net: Couldn't reach the server. Check your network.
coop.err.slow: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes and retry.
coop.shareManual: Give your friend the code on the screen to type in.
coop.shareText: Come support me in Cyber Shield! Room code: {code}
coop.guest.title: You're the supporter
coop.guest.lobby: You joined {name}, who is picking a stage…
coop.wait.title: Wait for your friend
coop.wait.shop: Your friend is in the shop…
coop.waitPeer.title: Wait for your friend
coop.waitPeer.text: {name} is finishing the questions… You start together when they are done.
coop.waitPeer.away: {name} lost the connection for a moment… Waiting for them so you start together.
coop.away: Your friend lost the connection. They are shielded while we wait…

coop.shopFriend: Your friend is in the shop, shielded: guard the arena!
coop.shopTime: Shop time is up: back to the fight!
coop.shopShield: You're shielded in the shop. Your friend fights alone, so hurry!
fight.close: Near the monster: you hit harder!
coop.wait.lost: You both fell! Your friend is preparing a new try…
coop.wait.fight: Your friend is in a battle now. You will join in a moment…
coop.wait.quiz: Your friend answers… watch and learn

coop.down.me: You fell! Your friend can save you
coop.down.friend: Your friend fell! Stand near to give a heart
coop.revived: Your friend is back in the fight!
coop.boxFriend: Your friend is on a box question: guard them!
coop.boxMe: Answer fast: your friend is alone!
coop.thanks: Boss beaten! Thanks for your support.
